title: Chapter 408
paragraphs: Chapter 408
Episode 120. Why Highlan? (2)
Everyone who witnessed the scene couldn't help but be shocked. There were many warriors who were stunned by the sight of Grunnel, which was left without a scratch.
It was not a decisive attack or a secret technique used.
It was a proper strike, not a full-powered blow.
Even so, the fact that Ron Highlan's sword qi produced such a futile result was something no one present could have imagined.
Except for Belakt and Cho, who were at the forefront of Grunnel.
'Ron's sword qi... was completely blocked?'
Jindo couldn't take his eyes off Grunnel for a while, shocked.
'There is an invisible shield around the entire hull.'
He didn't notice it right away due to the dizzying energy emitted by the lightning and sword qi, but Grunnel was surrounded by an intangible shield made of magic.
It was impossible to know how they formed this invisible shield. It could only be guessed that some kind of power was added to the magic.
Heavy silence fell among the warriors, and the giant magical beasts and biological golems were tearing apart the castle again, screaming.
The magical beasts and biological golems' momentum was not as great as before.
They also seemed to be somewhat intimidated by the Grunnel floating in the sky, as if they were fearful.
Ron and Belakt's gazes collided in the middle of the air.
Ron was only momentarily flustered by the fact that his sword qi was blocked, and he returned to his demeanor as the absolute ruler of Geomhwang Castle.
Belakt immediately recognized the desire flickering in those deep eyes.
It was the gaze of a ferocious beast whose blood was boiling after meeting a rival; it had been a long time since Belakt had met an opponent with such eyes.
Chuckle, Ha!
Hahaha...!
Suddenly, Ron let out a laugh while holding his forehead. Tears welled up in his eyes as if it was the funniest joke he'd ever heard in his life.
The ground shook every time Ron laughed.
The giant magical beasts stopped moving, crushed by the energy in that sound, and the biological golems tumbled to the ground. The warriors nearby even had to put up a protective barrier.
It was after about a minute of laughter that Ron spoke next.
"It seems you think you're Shilon Runkandel, Belakt Sidrikker. Or is it that you have too much faith in that pile of scrap metal?"
Ron shook his head as he wiped away his tears.
On the other hand, the subtle smile on Belakt's face was disappearing.
It wasn't because he felt insulted or Ron's mockery was unpleasant.
He felt it.
He could sense the flow of explosive aura that Ron was emitting was changing.
The aura that had been erupting fiercely like an active volcano was being refined in an instant.
Like light converging to a single point, it was gathering incredibly quickly and quietly towards Rashid.
Those who had not reached that level were unable to notice the change happening.
However, most of those who had reached that level also failed to perceive that Ron had swung his sword once after the aura was refined.
'Just now, something...'
He sliced through the air.
Even Jin, who was right beside him, recognized Rashid's trajectory in the air half a beat late. But he only recognized it, not confirmed it with his naked eye.
It was such a swift strike.
Fssst-!
A crack appeared in the transparent shield covering Grunnel.
The sword qi that tore the shield was formless, colorless, soundless, and shapeless.
It was only the realization of Ron Highlan, the peerless warrior.
It was the pinnacle of the sword that only Ron Highlan of the current generation of warriors had reached.
Highlan, who had reached the level that the saints called the Formless Sword, could truly become the rightful owner of the title "Sword Emperor."
It was a different level than simply using the title as the lord of Geomhwang Castle.
"Baekrang Tribe, beastmen."
Shaak!
The formless sword qi pierced Grunnel's shield once again.
Cho hid behind Belakt without understanding why the shield was being destroyed.
As the warriors had never imagined Ron's sword qi would fail to damage Grunnel, Cho had never thought that the invisible and mysterious force would break Grunnel's shield.
"To put it simply, you're beasts. While there are occasionally loyal and admirable beasts, most are ignorant and noisy mongrels."
As the transparent shield was cut by the formless sword qi, the space around Grunnel was distorted.
"Especially evil beasts like you, who recklessly threaten people without fear, must be put down whenever they are seen."
"Considering that you are called the Sword Emperor among humans, I showed you some respect. But all I get in return is a cheap play on words. I wonder who the real beast is..."
"Belakt Sidrikker, the harmful beast. You're still looking down at me from the ship."
As Ron finished speaking, Belakt drew the greatsword he had been carrying on his back.
Clang-!
Soon after, the formless sword completely tore Grunnel's shield apart and struck Belakt's sword spirit.
Dozens of invisible sword qi were slashing at various parts of Grunnel. The protrusions that formed the thunderclouds were cut off lifelessly, and fragments flew as the hull shook continuously.
A roar...!
The shaking Grunil seemed like it could crash at any moment.
It was unbelievable that the ship, which had been unscathed after being struck by a massive sword energy, was now on the verge of destruction.
A blow containing mere 'power' and a blow achieved through 'enlightenment' belonged to entirely different dimensions.
Ron was actually using even less aura than when he first attacked Grunil.
However, something else, like mental strength or willpower, was being consumed.
'Indeed, this is the caliber of a martial artist who has been competing with my father for the longest time.'
Watching Ron's sword, Jin felt a chilling sensation down his spine.
The limits and horizons of swords Jin had known up to this point were shattered, and a new realm seemed to open.
Despite the urgent and dizzying situation, Ron's intangible swordsmanship was an enticing state.
"Lord, Lord Belract! Something's wrong. What on earth is breaking Grunil...! Could it be that damn kid playing some trick?"
Cold-hearted Jo, he had been unable to shake off his fear of Jin since the collapse of the Dark Magic Society.
'It wasn't for nothing that Chukon Tolderer was afraid of him...!'

Moreover, with his poor vision and senses, Jo couldn't even perceive Ron swinging his sword, let alone experience the unique and transcendent realm of intangible swordsmanship. He mistakenly believed that the power destroying Grunil was Jin's.
Belract was so astounded by Jo's behavior that he couldn't speak.
"Jo, you trash-like... guy!"
Bang! Crack!
Belract's speech was interrupted as he blocked the intangible sword.
"This invisible sword energy is Ron Hiran's power, not that brat's. Get a grip and find the deputy chief's group before I tear you apart!"
"Uh, yes! Invisible sword energy, right. There's no way that brat could have such incredible power; I must have lost my senses for a moment."
"Shut up and find the deputy chief's group!"
Deputy Chief's Group.
Ron knew that it meant Vishukel and Marjiella, and their followers.
That's why he was curious.
Before the fact about Kinzello became known, Vishukel was known as the hope to revive the fallen Ebrilianog.
Neither of them were considered to have enough potential to shake the world, as martial artists like Shiron or Ron would pay close attention to.
Yet, the strongest of the Baeklang tribe, who had enough power to shake the world, and a mysterious ship, sought Hiran to rescue Vishukel and his party.

'Is it because they want to turn a blind eye to terrorism, or does Vishukel have some extraordinary ability? To begin with, it was strange that Vishukel Ebriliano was the deputy chief of those ambiguous guys.'
There was a need to capture them.
"Sword Emperor Castle! Secure Vishukel Ebriliano and his entourage of new recruits."
"Yes!"
"If the resistance is too fierce, you may kill them. Capture or kill, one of the two must be carried out!"
"Yes, sir!"
Although the giant monster and the living golems were almost cleared, the problem was the ship Grunil, and the energy of Jo and Beract who were operating it.
Kwaaaaaa-!
At Beract's roar, the knights on the ground flinched and froze.
In particular, the outstanding ones reflexively spread a protective shield and protected their bodies, but those who couldn't do so bled from their ears and mouths.
Beract's roar damaged their internal organs and tore their eardrums.
As the knights' movements faltered, a decision had to be made.
Should they look for Bishkel like they came looking for Veradin?
'...This time, it's right to protect the people inside the fortress.'
He didn't think long and made that conclusion.
The battle between Ron and Beract was just beginning.
Once the two started fighting in earnest, people could die every second just from the shockwaves.
Beract's statement that everyone in the castle would die wasn't entirely bluster.
Knowing that fact, Ron didn't give Jin a special order to find Bishkel this time.
The task for Jin and the warriors in the castle who had reached the ranks of superhumans was to protect others from the fight between the two and the ship Grunil.
The intangible sword was rushing toward Grunil more violently. Beract was fending off the transparent sword qi with only his senses, but now it seemed like he had reached his limit.
Even Beract couldn't protect Grunil from the intangible sword while fighting.
Since losing Grunil so easily wasn't an option, Beract had no choice but to throw himself to the ground.
If Grunil was destroyed, there would be a serious problem in returning with the vice commander's party.
Thud...!
Beract landed on the ground and narrowed his eyes.
Ron pointed his sword at Beract and smiled.
"You finally came down, beast."
"Ron Hyeran, you will regret dragging me down."
"However, you are a large beast. Judging by the fact that your eye level is still higher than mine."
Suddenly, Beract's right thigh was cut, and blood splattered.
It wasn't deep, but he allowed an effective hit as soon as he got off Grunil.
Moreover, Ron didn't even swing Rashid directly at Beract.
He had gathered the intangible sword qi floating in the air like the wind with his will.
"If you kneel down, it seems like it will be just the right height, don't you think?"
Ron smiled and added that remark.
